半山腰，韩灵四人跟在节目组后面，慢腾腾的往上面挪。

参加录制的一共八人，可以自由选择路线，每个人只需要跟两名摄影师就可以了。

而节目组的大部队，是跟着夏萱的。

“萱姐说要休息，导演，我们休息一下吧。”夏萱的助理跑到导演面前，态度很倨傲的说了一声，没等导演说话，又蹭蹭的跑回了夏萱身边。

导演无奈的让众人休息。

韩灵抱着工作人员给自己的冰水，咕咚咕咚的喝了两口，无语的看着前面被几个人忙前忙后伺候的夏萱，“这都休息了六遍了，才爬到一半，等上去天都黑了，早知道就跟着晚姐走了。”

另外三人感觉围了过来，方瑾瑜狡黠的笑了笑，“我现在知道晚姐要我们跟节目走是为了什么了。”

“为了什么？”

方瑾瑜晃了晃手机，以几人练出来的默契，不用说，也立即明白过来。

四个人围在一起，低声的讨论着，大部分是方瑾瑜和韩灵在说，言泽和姜明在听。

“喂，你们拿个人去山下帮萱姐买矿泉水。”夏萱的助理不知什么时候站在了四人旁边，颐指气使的吩咐了一句。

四周的工作人员此时都散得比较开，他们四个离得较近，又是平均年龄不到二十的少女少年，于是就被夏萱的助理给盯上了。

方瑾瑜抬头看了那个助理一眼，“节目组不是有水吗？”

“萱姐不喝那个牌子的，叫你们去就去，废话怎么那么多。”

“抱歉，我们不是剧组的工作人员。”言泽起身，礼貌的冲那助理笑了笑，“姐姐可以让工作人员去帮萱姐买，你看……我们也很累。”

助理皱了下眉，讽刺道：“年轻人就该多锻炼锻炼，只是跑腿买个水，你们就不乐意？想在这个圈子混，处世为人是最重要的。”

韩灵拉住言泽，不让他继续说，“请问萱姐要喝什么牌子的矿泉水？我们这就去帮萱姐买。”

“这才懂规矩。”

助理将夏萱要的牌子名字告诉他们，让他们赶紧去买，随后就趾高气昂的走了。

“韩灵，你拉着我做什么？”言泽有些气愤，那女人明显就是再欺负他们。

“夏萱是影后，影响力极大，她身边的人虽然做事不太好，但是你看她，对谁都温温柔柔的，就连导演都被她哄得高高兴兴的，我们连道都还没出，怎么和她硬碰硬？”

韩灵年纪最大，比另外的三人都看得透彻一些。

“那就这么算了？”方瑾瑜也有些不忿。

Halfway up the mountain, Han Ling and four others followed the program crew and moved up slowly.

There are a total of eight people participating in the recording. They can choose their route freely. Each person only needs to follow two photographers.

The large team of the program team followed Xia Xuan.

"Sister Xuan said we need to rest, director, let's take a rest." Xia Xuan's assistant ran to the director and said in a very arrogant manner. Before the director could speak, she ran back to Xia Xuan.

The director reluctantly asked everyone to rest.

Han Ling held the ice water given to her by the staff and took two sips. She looked speechlessly at Xia Xuan in front of her who was being served by several people. "I have rested six times before I climbed halfway. It will be dark when I get up. If I had known better, I would have followed Sister Wan."

The other three people seemed to be surrounding them, and Fang Jinyu smiled slyly, "Now I know why Sister Wan wants us to follow the show."

"For what?"

Fang Jinyu shook her phone, and with the tacit understanding developed by several people, she understood immediately.

Four people gathered together and discussed in low voices. Most of them were Fang Jinyu and Han Ling, while Yan Ze and Jiang Ming were listening.

"Hey, take one of you to the bottom of the mountain to help Sister Xuan buy mineral water." Xia Xuan's assistant stood next to the four of them at some point and gave a commanding order.

The staff around them were all spread out at this time. The four of them were relatively close, and they were girls and teenagers with an average age of less than 20, so they were targeted by Xia Xuan's assistant.

Fang Jinyu raised her head and glanced at the assistant, "Don't the program crew have water?"

"Sister Xuan doesn't drink that brand. Just go if you are told. Why are you talking so much nonsense?"

"Sorry, we are not the staff of the crew." Yan Ze stood up and smiled politely at the assistant, "Sister, you can ask the staff to buy it for Sister Xuan. You see... we are also very tired."

The assistant frowned and said sarcastically: "Young people should exercise more. Aren't you happy if you just run errands and buy water? If you want to get involved in this circle, behaving well is the most important thing."

Han Ling stopped Yan Ze and stopped him from continuing, "Excuse me, what brand of mineral water does Sister Xuan want to drink? We will buy it for Sister Xuan right now."

"This is how you understand the rules."

The assistant told them the name of the brand Xia Xuan wanted and asked them to buy it quickly, and then left proudly.

"Han Ling, why are you holding me back?" Yan Ze was a little angry. The woman obviously wanted to bully them again.

"Xia Xuan is a movie queen and has great influence. Although the people around her are not doing well, look at her, she is gentle and gentle to everyone. Even the director is coaxed happily by her. We haven't even come out yet, so how can we confront her head-on?"

Han Ling is the oldest and sees things more clearly than the other three.

"Then let's forget it?" Fang Jinyu was also a little unhappy.
